svg.text: The body map, at the resolution the team needs
Front and back at 5 cm cells, the head twice. 110 drawn places for every address inside the body, all 112 but the 4 outside it. Proposed, not built. Generated by proto/body-map-spec/gen.js.

g.text: side to side and height only
person's right on the left, as on every front view
The 11 filled dots on the centre line hold 19 addresses, stacked in one column.
front to back and height: the one side view needed
The same places spread out. Front to back values approximate, about 10 mm.

svg.text: measured and in the engine today (atlas, spine or his charts)
measured, belongs on the back, drawn on the front today
proposed on 27 September (FW), not in the engine
inside the skull, placed from the brain atlas
A number beside a dot: that many addresses stand on one place. A bigger dot holds more.
Grid cell: 5 cm on a 175 cm person, the resolution this spec proposes
Dashed ring on the front figure: one 44 pixel fingertip on a phone, whole body. 22 cm of body.
Solid ring: the same fingertip with the torso opened on a phone. 5.5 cm.
Head: on the front the 11 midline places sit a median 6.1 mm from their nearest neighbour. Cut down the middle, 18 mm.
The cut's front to back values are approximate (about 10 mm), typed from atlas centroids.
The atlas pass (BQ) measured them and the engine kept only two of the three coordinates.
14 measured addresses belong on the back and are drawn on the front today. The pain map is front only.
Arms and legs hold 2 addresses. The marma chart puts 44 of its 107 points there.
